title: POPP model
description: A Problem-Oriented Project Planning model: a forest of homogeneous trees per node kind and typed relations between nodes of different trees (format version 1). Rules the schema cannot express: ids are unique across the whole model; a relation's type must match the kinds of its source and target (causes: problem -> consequence or goal -> success criterion; inverts: problem -> goal; realizes: solution -> goal; produces: solution -> success proof; validates: success proof -> success criterion); two nodes have at most one relation.

trees.description: The roots of the trees of each kind; children are nested and share their root's kind. A missing array is an empty one.

decomposition.description: How the node is decomposed into its children; only for nodes with children (default and).

layout.description: Position in the diagram (optional, not part of the POPP metamodel).
